opening.text: I've been having stomach pain for the last two weeks. It's a burning sensation, and when it hits, it's about a 7 out of 10, though it can go down to zero. Sometimes I feel nauseated when the pain is there, and I actually vomited at one point. I take ibuprofen for my knee arthritis and Maalox. Also, my father died of pancreatic cancer at 55.
